curation_note: World ideas and structural improvements are proposals, not confirmed upstream defects. Inspect the selected code before authoring; do not degrade healthy source to manufacture a task.

categories.name: 0→1 construction and feature development
categories.objective: Deliver a useful bounded product or capability from a public contract; permit independent architecture.
categories.coverage_note: Available behavioral references; construction contracts and acceptance cases still need authoring.

categories.name: Refactoring and code quality
categories.objective: Preserve behavior while achieving a concrete structural improvement, not generic cleanup.
categories.coverage_note: Available working-tree references; baseline behavior and structural acceptance need qualification.

categories.name: Environment, build, and release
categories.objective: Produce reproducible artifacts that install and work in a clean environment.
categories.coverage_note: Available packaging/build anchors; native fixtures and offline dependency caches need selection.

categories.name: Performance and resource optimization
categories.objective: Improve an actual target workload under correctness and resource constraints.
categories.coverage_note: Workload pairing required: a benchmark instrument alone is not an optimization task.

categories.name: Applied data analysis and decision support
categories.objective: Answer a stakeholder question with correct transformations, defensible inference, and uncertainty.
categories.coverage_note: Real data sources exist; individual datasets, questions, and reference calculations are not yet selected.

categories.name: ML experimentation
categories.objective: Establish, improve, and honestly evaluate a leakage-safe model under an experiment budget.
categories.coverage_note: Pair a bounded pipeline with a frozen dataset and sealed evaluation split.

categories.name: Constructive science and algorithms
categories.objective: Construct and validate a numerical model, algorithm, or optimization solution.
categories.coverage_note: Solver/model anchors exist; independently checkable problem instances need qualification.

categories.name: Professional artifact production
categories.objective: Deliver an audience-specific report or other useful artifact with reproducible substantive content.
categories.coverage_note: Report authoring plus data pairing required; converting a notebook alone is not sufficient.

categories.name: Evolving operational workflows
categories.objective: Complete authorized actions, monitor effects, respond to changes, and recover with persisted state.
categories.coverage_note: Authored evolving labs required; static services and deployment examples are not complete workflows.

categories.name: Adversarial information handling
categories.objective: Complete the legitimate task without granting untrusted content authority over protected actions or disclosures.
categories.coverage_note: Overlay-only coverage: no dedicated adversarial-source repository is claimed in this roster.

qualification_gates: Fetch only the chosen commit and selected files/data into a disposable private directory; inventory handwritten code, assets, generated/vendored content, and fixture bytes.
Inspect pinned licenses and required notices, plus each data source's terms; GitHub SPDX detection is not legal clearance and does not cover every external asset.
Select a coherent public contract and supported behavior. Construction may use an empty workspace; refactoring must start from a behaviorally characterized working tree.
Freeze dependency versions, toolchains, binaries, input hashes, dataset observation dates, and local services. Prepare offline caches where needed.
Run the original baseline and independently compute reference facts. For repair variants demonstrate the initial failure; for refactoring variants preserve a known-good baseline.
Execute consequential tests, joins, fits, benchmarks, and state transitions under the GM's private materialization root; never let plausible narration establish correctness.
Validate at least one correct alternative and several plausible wrong solutions. Hidden tests may enforce public requirements but not unspecified upstream quirks or source similarity.
Precommit evolving events and trust boundaries. Use fictional secrets and controlled sinks; never production credentials, public pushes, real email delivery, or uncontrolled exfiltration.
Keep implementations, articles, private answers, and validators outside the agent-visible solution surface; control oracle fetching while retaining legitimate dependency/documentation access.
Pilot repeated no-training rollouts for simulator consistency, leakage, reward discrimination, runtime, and cost; only then author and explicitly promote world files through worlds/manifest.json.
